nodes.title: Owner: Gemini (Vertex) may process call audio and text wherever Google processes it: the US, EU or global endpoints are acceptable.

Owner: no Google Cloud project was created on compliance@carbonsettle.com. VP uses Vertex only from team@vyakti.ai, project vp-voice. The owner made the new key and checked the console personally; Instinct was not used.

Owner: the product UI is never written in Hindi or Hinglish (e.g. a 'Suprabhat, Asha' greeting is unacceptable). VP is a world-class product for medium-to-large Indian enterprises first; small businesses only by use case. Every screen must read as professional enterprise software. The agents' spoken Hinglish on calls is the product's voice, not UI copy.

Owner: the user selects the whole voice stack, component by component (ears/STT, brain, voice/TTS, or a speech-to-speech engine), at least for testing. A default stack is also offered. Which components work best is decided later, from real use-case calls on the finished product.
Owner: route every model by availability. Gemini goes through Vertex. Anything available in Azure AI Foundry goes through Azure Foundry. Only what is in neither goes through OpenRouter.

Owner restated the bar. VP must beat every competitor on quality, value and price: emotional, relational, expressive agents that are self-learning and personalised, deliver better conversions and metrics, offer world-class UI/UX and product journeys, and are run through LLM agents so the user does less and makes fewer mistakes. The analytics and the learning are LLM-driven. Nothing gimmicky.

The new vp-voice service-account key (id ending 4589e6) was pasted in chat by the owner, who said that is acceptable. A pasted key was one of the three suspected triggers of the 2026-10-20 restriction.
nodes.mitigation: Use it only from the India VM and keep the ramp (no batches for 48 h, then at most 1 request/s). Once the lab is stable, offer the owner a rotation through the write-only upload path, so the live key has never been in chat.
